title: KIVIK chaise
description: KIVIK chaise, Tallmyra dark green A chaise longue is perfect when you want to stretch out for a while. Read a good book, watch a movie or play video games. KIVIK chaise longue can be used freestanding or in combination with your sofa. The chaise can stand alone or be added onto the sofas.
materialAndCare: Smolder resistant lining/ Smolder resistant lining: Polyester wadding; Back and seat frame: Fiberboard, Particleboard, Plywood, Solid wood; Seat cushion: High-resilience polyurethane foam (cold foam) 2.2 lb/cu.ft., Polyurethane foam 2.0 lb/cu.ft., Felt liner; Pocket spring unit: Steel; Back cushion: Polyester fiber balls; Back fabric: 100 % polyester (100% recycled); Fabric: 78 % cotton, 22 % polyester (100% recycled)
